summary: Ragged Hill tower: 1918 48-ft lookout, destroyed by the 1938 hurricane, rebuilt by the CCC in 1939 as a 60-ft steel tower; NHLR-registered 2004; no staffing or access sources found.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1917 report gives 50 feet for the tower purchased that year; the 1918 report, which says that tower was purchased the year before, gives 48 feet for the tower erected, and the Register also gives 48 feet for the original tower. The story reports both figures for the same tower and does not choose one.

sources.title: Southern New England Chapter report for 2015

notes_for_editor: Height 18.3 m is converted from the 60-foot figure in Forest Lookouts; the Register gives no height in feet. Access, staffing, notable fires and condition after 2015 were not found in the six pages read, so no access or staffing facts are recorded and the brief's access 'unknown' stands. Two FFLA Massachusetts Chapter Facebook posts about Ragged Hill could not be read (login wall) and are not used. As reported in search snippets only, they describe a 60' International Derrick built 1933 with a 1966 cab replacement, and one links an Aermotor tag; the two disagree on the maker and the 1933 date is not supported by any page read, so check them by hand if they can be reached. Unread leads: the Town of West Brookfield fire department site and the Bureau of Forest Fire Control, for current access and condition.
